issue.title: Copy and command chips on nested list bullets never render in Live Preview (indented-code regex)

task_type_fields.impact: Copy and command chips on nested bullets render as plain inline code in Live Preview, with no pill, no click-to-copy, and no click-to-run. The ⌘↵ task-fallback target on a child bullet cannot show its armed accent, although ⌘↵ still runs it and the keycap on the task line names it. bob-cli-nu.6 saw this in the Obsidian e2e screenshot keymap-task-fallback.png. The bug predates command chips and came in with the copy-chip epic (bob-cli-ni).
task_type_fields.repro:
In bob-plugins (master ee941a1+), load the bob-chips helpers and call the Live Preview line scanner on nested bullets:

```bash
node -e 'const { helpers } = require("./scripts/copy-chips-test-helpers.cjs");
for (const l of ["\t- `run: bob plan`", "    - `copy: x`", "- `copy: x`"])
  console.log(JSON.stringify(l), helpers.chipLiveChipsForLine(l, 0, null).length);'
```

Output: `0`, `0`, `1`. `copyChipLiveLineIsIndentedCode` (`/^(?: {4}|\t)\S/`) treats every tab- or 4-space-indented line, which includes every nested list bullet, as an indented code block. So `chipLiveChipsForLine` returns `[]` for copy and command chips on child bullets. Reading view is unaffected.

Root cause: `plugins/bob-chips/src/050-live-preview.js` `copyChipLiveLineIsIndentedCode`, called from `chipLiveChipsForLine` and the decoration builder (line ~556). Fix: when the syntax tree is available, rely on `copyChipLivePosIsInlineCode` (it already rejects codeblock nodes), and keep the regex only as the tree-less fallback, or skip the regex for list-item continuation lines. Add Live Preview vectors for tab- and 4-space-nested bullets. Bump bob-chips (patch), npm run build/test/validate, and bob plugins sync.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-nu.6 (note #3) and triaged by the bob-cli-nu land agent; a pre-existing copy-chip Live Preview bug that now also hides command-chip pills and the armed ⌘↵ cue on child bullets.
